articles.title: Shakira and Burna Boy's World Cup Anthem 'Dai Dai' Is STILL the Biggest Song Outside the U.S.!
articles.summary: Imagine 80,000 fans screaming as Shakira and Burna Boy performed 'Dai Dai' at the World Cup opening! That song just held onto #1 for a second week on a huge global chart. Ariana Grande also bounced back to #1 on a different worldwide list.

articles.title: Minions & Monsters Didn't Smash Box Office Records — But It's Still a Winner!
articles.summary: The new Minions movie opened with $36.4 million in the U.S., which is less than past films. But it already made $98.4 million overseas, and it's the highest-rated Illumination film ever with 91% on Rotten Tomatoes. So the little yellow guys are still going strong!

articles.title: The Studio That Made Dishonored Might Be Sold — And Its Founder Wants to Buy It!
articles.summary: Arkane Lyon, the studio behind cool games like Dishonored and the upcoming Marvel's Blade, might be closed or sold by Xbox. The original founder, Raphael Colantonio, jokingly asked Xbox's CEO 'how much?' on social media. Negotiations are happening now.
